endpoint.name: headlessExternalReady
endpoint.definition: The QML monotonic ElapsedTimer over passesPerLaunch identical complete walks of the boot-turn stream, divided by the pass count, taken when the final v1 framed reply (real IpcProtocol.encode of a pilot report carrying only the common step sequence) is complete. The node driver decodes that frame before accepting the run. This is a headless per-pass proxy, NOT a single-launch boot endpoint.
endpoint.probeCadence: Every run executes the same fixture rows in the same order for the same number of passes, emits the same external step list (IPC registration/poll/ready, timer arms, pump enqueue/turn, loader adoption/teardown) and probes the frame once at the end. No variant-specific polling. A fresh recorder/pump/loader is built per pass so the recorder cannot saturate.
endpoint.clockResolutionNote: ElapsedTimer.elapsedMs() reported integer milliseconds on this host; normalising over 200 passes gives a 0.005 ms reported resolution floor. This is a resolution floor, not an accuracy claim.

censoring.nonStart: No ##DONE## sentinel, no readyMs line, or a spawn/transport error: the run is a non-start and is excluded from timing.
censoring.timeout: A run that exceeds probe.timeoutMs is killed as a process group and censored as a timeout.
censoring.pairRule: A block contributes to paired statistics only when BOTH variants completed. Censored runs are counted and reported, never imputed.
censoring.inconclusiveRule: If fewer than blocks.minimum complete pairs remain, or if censored runs exceed 10% of attempts, no p50/p95 effect claim is made.

cache.cold: A fresh XDG_CACHE_HOME is created for every launch; no prior identical launch seeds it; no decoder/icon caches are constructed by the probe (verified absent before each launch). This is a process-level cache-isolation PROXY, not verified QML disk-cache isolation.
cache.warm: One identical prior launch per variant seeds the shared XDG_CACHE_HOME before measurement; the same cache directory is reused for all measured launches. Whether quickshell writes any cache artifact is recorded, not assumed.

statistics.confidenceInterval: percentile 95% from block-level bootstrap (resample whole pairs with replacement)
statistics.effect: p95(traced) - p95(inert) for overhead; p95(candidate primary) - p95(baseline primary) for --compare

pinned.note: Pinned beside every result, never inside graphDigest. Observed values are re-read at run time; drift is reported, not silently accepted.
